emotional_tone: Warm, intelligent, sophisticated, calm, and highly capable.
design_philosophy: A modern, Claude-identical interface using warm, organic tones instead of sterile tech blues. Blends elegant serif typography for welcoming moments with highly legible sans-serif for reading dense AI outputs. Focuses on breathing room, subtle neumorphic layering, and tactile elements.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for containers. The chat bubbles must have p-4 to p-6.
layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid for the main layout (sidebar fixed on left taking 260px, main chat taking the rest). Sidebar must be fully collapsible on mobile. Mobile-first strategy.

surface_strategies.sidebar: Flat solid background with a sharp 1px right border (border-border_subtle). No shadow.
surface_strategies.chat_composer: Floating neumorphic pill centered at bottom. Soft shadow-lg, 1px border-border_subtle. Must expand dynamically as user types.
surface_strategies.modals: Crystal glassmorphism for overlays (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40), inner modal is flat solid #FDFDF9 with subtle rounded corners (rounded-2xl).

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all UI icons. Keep stroke width at 1.5 for a delicate, refined look.

buttons.primary: Solid primary color, text-white, rounded-full or rounded-xl, subtle scale down on active.
buttons.chat_action: Small circular icon buttons with hover:bg-black/5 transition for attachments and voice input.

auth_screens.layout: Split layout or centered elegant card. Left side/background uses minimalist texture. Right side has Google OAuth and Email OTP input fields.
auth_screens.typography: Welcome greeting must use the serif heading font (EB Garamond) at text-4xl.

chat_interface.messages: User messages: aligned right, soft gray background (bg-black/5), rounded-2xl. Assistant messages: aligned left, no background, pure text with markdown support and code blocks.
chat_interface.empty_state: Centered on screen. Large elegant serif greeting ('How can I help you today?'). Suggested prompts below in outline chips.
chat_interface.input_area: Bottom fixed. Contains model selector (Claus 3.5 Sonnet, etc.), attachment icon, voice input (microphone) icon, text area, send button.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios against the warm backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use gentle ease-in-out transitions for sidebar toggle and chat message pop-ins.

image_urls.description: Minimalist warm sand texture for the login screen background to evoke calm and premium organic feel.
Abstract elegant shape to be used as a decorative element or placeholder app icon.
Modern laptop desk visual for the 'Download Desktop App' section modal/page.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY these provided images. Do not use generic placeholders. Implement the UI mimicking the sophisticated nature of Claude using the Organic & Earthy archetype colors. Ensure voice input UI, 15-language selector, Google + OTP auth flow, and desktop download options are built as requested.
